correctness.rationale: The exact two-state carry matrices and geometric tail give the whole rational carry PGF. Its gap difference reduces to a positive finite convolution. The interval convolution changes by at most one per coefficient, giving the uniform lower bound 2/9 before scaling; the negative-index case proves plateau. Density limits follow from geometric carry survival. A standalone checker makes 972 exact transition checks and 45 separate residue-class checks.
